Frequently asked questions

Does the template automatically route promoters and detractors?

Yes. Conditional logic routes respondents based on their 0–10 score. Detractors (0–6) see "What went wrong?", passives (7–8) see "What could we improve?", and promoters (9–10) see "What do you love most?" — all set up in the template, editable.

How do I calculate NPS from FormflowX responses?

NPS = % Promoters (9–10) − % Detractors (0–6). FormflowX logs raw scores to Google Sheets. Use a COUNTIF formula on the score column: =((COUNTIF(B:B,">=9")-COUNTIF(B:B,">=7"))/COUNTA(B:B))*100 - (COUNTIF(B:B,"<=6")/COUNTA(B:B))*100

Can I get a Slack alert when a detractor responds?

Yes — via Zapier. Set up a Zapier filter: "Only continue if score ≤ 6", then send a Slack message. The message can include the score and follow-up answer so your team has context before reaching out.

Is this template free?

Yes. The NPS template is free to use on all FormflowX plans including the free tier (up to 100 responses/month). Conditional logic is included on every plan.
